name: smwgraphics-flowery-grassland
title: Flowery Grassland
description:
Originally an update to my old ugly-looking grassland tileset. I decided that this one looks different enough from the other one, so I'm releasing it separately.

Features:
- Uses 100% vanilla palettes;
- Has dancing flowers (and Munchers);
- Grass;
- Doesn't make your eyes bleed like the old one;
- All in a single graphics file.

Unfortunately the sleeping Muncher has passed. Enjoy.
